description: This Java class defines the configuration for a MongoDB connection pool, including parameters like max size, wait queue size, wait time, and JMX listener enablement. It provides methods to instantiate the configuration from a Config object and overrides standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionPoolConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing MongoDbConfig.ConnectionPoolConfig, encapsulating connection pool settings for MongoDB.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultConnectionPoolConfig from a Config object, using fallback values.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of the connection pool.

methods.name: getMaxWaitQueueSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum wait queue size.

methods.name: getMaxWaitTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum wait time for a connection.

methods.name: isJmxListenerEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether JMX listener is enabled.
